# InvalidLicenseTierException

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Thrown when `Tier` is assigned a value outside the `LicenseTier` enumeration — a typo or a bad cast in the consumer's startup code, not an undeclared licence.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `ArgumentException`.
